verdicts.reason: A has a clean vertical flow: a strong 3-line headline, an evenly spaced and left-aligned flavour list, a centred can and a CTA anchored at the bottom. Its flaws are the reordered list (Cherry, Mango, Cola, Grape, Lime instead of the original order), a FIZZBANG! logo pill shrunk to near-illegibility, and a tight left margin on the list. B has the same reordered list and tiny logo, and it is worse: its bullets are ragged (the Cola, Grape and Lime dots and labels sit at different x-offsets than Cherry and Mango), the list is jammed right under the headline with almost no gap, the headline runs close to both canvas edges, and the CTA button is small and weak.
